pages.title: Getting Started
pages.summary: Install the toolkit, bootstrap environments, and publish your first deployment pipeline.

body.content: The Unified Automation Platform ships with polyglot components for CI/CD, analytics, and compliance. To get started, install the command line utilities and initialize your workspace.

curl -sSL https://example.com/install.sh | bash
infra init --template enterprise

items: Provision shared secrets for each environment
Register Git, cloud, and observability integrations
Invite team members and assign least-privilege roles

body.content: After initialization, explore the dashboard at /web/index.php to monitor build progress in real time.

pages.title: Progressive Delivery
pages.summary: Release confidently with multi-stage deploys, automated health checks, and instant rollbacks.

body.content: Progressive delivery coordinates canary, blue/green, and feature flag strategies across heterogeneous runtimes. Configure a release track to define promotion criteria.
Promotion rules are evaluated continuously. Failing service level objectives pause the rollout automatically.

tracks:
  - name: production
    strategy: canary
    gates:
      - type: error_budget
        threshold: 2%
      - type: latency
        p95: 250ms

pages.title: Platform Architecture
pages.summary: Understand service boundaries, data flows, and the security envelope.

body.content: The platform is split into language-specific execution engines coordinated by the SmartPipeline orchestrator. Unified telemetry captures every stage for analytics and auditing.

items: Java orchestration with resilient job scheduling
Python analytics and ML forecasting services
Go dependency resolver and package mirror
C++ performance probes for critical paths
PHP/Tailwind control plane with granular RBAC

body.content: All services emit OpenTelemetry traces and share a unified configuration manifest for deterministic builds.

pages.title: Security Posture
pages.summary: Apply zero-trust defaults and orchestrate compliance workflows.

body.content: Security spans SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, and contextual policy checks. Every environment inherits secret rotation and tamper-evident audit logging.
